messages:
Leah: kickoff idea — run a 3-week lab sprint to ship 3 micro-tutorials + an OSS launch post. goals: fast first-run, benchmark appendix, webinar. :rocket:
Hector: +1. keep three tiers: 5m quickstart, 15m integrate, 30m optimize.
June: I can author the tutorials. will include a tiny eval harness and an 'expected outputs' file for regressions.
Ravi: I'll run perf sweeps and publish a CSV: tokens/sec, p50 latency, est $/1k tokens for baseline vs quantized. will tag runs with model+quant.
Marta: design will deliver 2 hero images and 1 explainer gif. also draft a 3-tweet thread and LinkedIn copy.
Leah: ops-bot — schedule a 30m kickoff Tue 10am and add a checklist in the repo. include closed beta invites (10 devs).
ops-bot: created calendar event "lab sprint kickoff" Tue 10:00 — invites sent to Leah, Hector, June, Ravi, Marta. checklist: https://git.redwood/internal/refapps/lab-sprint/board
Hector: suggest A/B test headlines on the landing: A) "Start in 5 minutes" B) "See real inference savings". track signups + time-to-first-run.
Leah: agreed. next steps: June + Hector draft outlines by Fri EOD; Ravi reserve infra Wed-Thu for perf runs; Marta prepare assets by Mon. keep copy dev-focused and actionable.
